أستئم (form X)
# أَسْتَئِمُّ (ʔastaʔimmu) /ʔas.ta.ʔim.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# أَسْتَئِمَّ (ʔastaʔimma) /ʔas.ta.ʔim.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# أَسْتَئِمِّ (ʔastaʔimmi) /ʔas.ta.ʔim.mi/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
